title: Transcript Dock
description: Use your Transcript Dock API key. Captions cost 1 credit. AI transcription costs 2 credits per started minute on paid plans. Apify compute usage is separate.

apiKey.title: Transcript Dock API key
apiKey.description: Your key from Transcript Dock. It is stored encrypted by Apify.

urls.title: Video links
urls.description: Up to 50 public YouTube, TikTok or Instagram Reel links.

mode.title: Transcription mode
mode.description: AI requires a paid Transcript Dock plan. Instagram needs auto or transcribe mode.

maxCredits.title: Credit cap per video
maxCredits.description: Maximum Transcript Dock credits for each video. Multiply by your link count for the run cap.

timeoutSeconds.title: Wait per video in seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: When the wait ends, the output includes the current job status and ID. The job may still finish later.
